pp1.3:6.1: Arukūpamacitto puggalo, vijjūpamacitto puggalo, vajirūpamacitto puggalo. (6)
pp1.3:8.1: Avakujjapañño puggalo, ucchaṅgapañño puggalo, puthupañño puggalo. (8)
pp1.3:9.1: Atthekacco puggalo kāmesu ca bhavesu ca avītarāgo, atthekacco puggalo kāmesu vītarāgo bhavesu avītarāgo, atthekacco puggalo kāmesu ca bhavesu ca vītarāgo. (9)
pp1.3:10.1: Pāsāṇalekhūpamo puggalo, pathavilekhūpamo puggalo, udakalekhūpamo puggalo. (10)
pp1.3:14.1: Atthekacco puggalo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo, atthekacco puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo, atthekacco puggalo sakkatvā garuṃ katvā sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo. (14)
pp1.3:15.1: Atthekacco puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo, atthekacco puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo;
pp1.3:16.1: Atthekacco puggalo sīlesu paripūrakārī , samādhismiṃ mattaso kārī, paññāya mattaso kārī;
pp1.3:16.2: atthekacco puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī, samādhismiñca paripūrakārī, paññāya mattaso kārī;
pp1.3:16.3: atthekacco puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī, samādhismiñca paripūrakārī, paññāya ca paripūrakārī. (16)
